name: Registration form validates, then creates the account
expected: An empty or inconsistent form goes nowhere; a valid one tells the student to verify email and returns to Login
actual: empty submit blocked by the browser; mismatched passwords flagged (4 field(s)); then the corrected form: Login now says "Account created. Check your email to verify your address, then log in."

name: Email verification
expected: An unverified account is held on the verification page; after the emailed link is opened, "I have verified" lets the student in
actual: held on the verification page ("not verified yet"); after the link was opened, redirected to Student Home

name: Student Home shows real data only
expected: Three demo rooms with status for now, no upcoming reservations, an honest announcements notice, the student number
actual: rooms: Discussion Room A = Free now; Discussion Room B = Free now; Discussion Room C = Free now; "You have no upcoming reservations."; Student no. DEMO-1001

name: Password recovery
expected: The reset page gives the same answer for any address; the emailed link sets a new password that then works, the old one does not
actual: same message for a real and an unknown address ("If an account exists for that email, a p..."); reset link worked once; old password refused; new password signs in

name: Sign-in errors and denied accounts
expected: Wrong password and unknown user look identical; the suspended and the unverified accounts are handled
actual: "Incorrect email or password." (both wrong password and unknown user); suspended: "This account is not active. Please contact the library."

name: Nora generates a Silent Room stub
expected: A stub with a seat, a stub id and a QR code; it appears under Active stubs and in History
actual: Silent Seat 1, SR-M464KN87Z4, QR decodes to NUFV1:tuY-EqIhnKuOBNHoz3gByg4u; 1 active, 1 in history

name: Administrator scans the QR payload
expected: The scanner shows the student, the seat and "ISSUED"
actual: ISSUED — Issued. Waiting for the student to check in.; Ticket ID SR-M464KN87Z4 Service Silent Room Student Nora Villanueva (DEMO-1001) Assignment Silent Seat 1 Issued Oct 13,

name: Check-in needs the identity confirmation
expected: The Check in button stays disabled until the ID box is ticked; then the student is checked in
actual: button disabled until ticked; then "Checked in." and banner CHECKED IN

name: Check-out frees the seat
expected: The stub becomes "CHECKED OUT"; the student sees it in History; the seat is free again
actual: banner CHECKED OUT; student History shows checked out, Active empty; Silent Room card: "Silent Room A quiet study seat, assigned to you automatically. 3 of 3 free"

name: Ana generates a Computer Station stub
expected: A stub with a computer, id CS-...
actual: Computer 1, CS-7810CPKHKB

name: Administrator revokes it with a reason
expected: Revoking asks for a reason; the stub becomes REVOKED; the student loses it
actual: banner: REVOKED — Revoked: Demonstration: wrong student at the desk.; the student's Active list is empty and History shows revoked

name: Ben generates a demo Wi-Fi voucher and retrieves its password
expected: The voucher shows a clearly-marked demo password, the same one every time it is opened
actual: password DEMO-L4U2-Z4PM-RQL5 (demo banner shown, same password on reopening); QR NUFV1:7V0jg6sm2_2t0edr_xve9a5X

name: Dashboard overview
expected: Cards for the three resource types and the current settings
actual: 3 resource cards, 9 settings facts; 3resources silent seats

name: Resource creation
expected: A new computer station is added through the form and appears in the inventory
actual: 8 -> 9 resources; "Resource added."

name: Resource validation
expected: A duplicate identifier and an empty form are refused with a message
actual: empty: "Identifier and label are required."; duplicate: "A resource with this id already exists."

name: Maintenance and two-step retire
expected: Two stations go into maintenance (a status change); a throwaway seat is retired only on the second click
actual: pc-02 and pc-03 maintenance, temp-01 retired after a second "Confirm retire" click (10 rows)

name: System settings
expected: A setting is changed, versioned and restored
actual: 180 -> 200 ("Settings saved (version 1).") -> restored; 5 minutes refused: "wifiVoucherMinutes must be between 15 and 1440."

name: Scanner rejects what is not a library code
expected: Garbage gets a clear message; an unknown but well-formed code is "no match"
actual: "That is not a library code. Scan the QR code on a stub or a ..."; unknown stub: "No stub matches this code."; unknown reservation: "No reservation matches this code."

name: Carla submits a reservation (form validation first)
expected: An incomplete form is refused in place; a complete one is submitted and waits for the Dean
actual: empty form: blocked by the browser's required-field check (form invalid); no request sent; then: "Request submitted (RS-Y0XMJBXNRC). It is waiting for: College Dean. Follow its progress in My Reservations"

name: The Dean approves through the emailed link
expected: Link -> request a code -> code from the email -> review shows the student and room -> approve
actual: review showed: Requested by Carla Lim (DEMO-0003) Room Discussion Room A Date 2026-10-14 Time 09:00 – 10:00 (Asia/Manila) Participants 2: Carla L; result: "Approved"

name: The Library Adviser approves next, only after the Dean
expected: The second approver is notified only now; approving moves it to the final administrator
actual: student's progress: College Dean: approved | Library Adviser: approved | Final administrator approval: waiting for a decision

name: Administrator gives the final approval
expected: The request appears as "Needs your decision"; approving confirms the booking
actual: "Approved. The booking is confirmed."

name: The student gets a confirmation with a QR; the administrator verifies it
expected: The confirmation shows reference RC-..., its QR decodes to NUFR1:..., and scanning it shows a confirmed booking that is not valid yet
actual: confirmation RC-1RJE4636TW; QR NUFR1:2wKiTZ9mNjF8D1_NQdkw2q4i; scanner: CONFIRMED — Not valid right now. The booking has not started yet.

name: A rejection reaches the student with its reason
expected: The Dean rejects with a comment; the student sees Rejected and the reason; the room is released
actual: Dean: "Rejected"; student sees: "Reason given: Room reserved for a faculty meeting"

name: Two students race for the last free computer station
expected: Exactly one gets a stub; the other is told none is free
actual: winner: eli; the other saw: "No computer station seat is free right now. Please try again later."

name: Two students submit the same room and time at the same moment
expected: Exactly one request is accepted; the other is told the slot is taken
actual: winner dev.patel (RS-3DAVFP7VCN); the other saw: "That room is already reserved or being reviewed for part of this time. Choose another time or room."

name: The winner cancels (two-step) and the room is released
expected: Cancel asks for a second click; the reservation shows cancelled
actual: "Reservation cancelled. The room is free for others."; card status: cancelled

name: The other student now gets the same slot
expected: The same room and time that was refused a moment ago is accepted
actual: "Request submitted (RS-EXVJ2WKMX3). It is waiting for: College Dean. Follow its progress in"

name: Reservation management
expected: Statuses are filterable; confirmed, rejected, cancelled and pending requests are each listed
actual: rows per status: {"pending":1,"confirmed":1,"rejected":1,"cancelled":1}

name: Approval workflow configuration
expected: The chain is edited (step time), saved with a new version, and restored
actual: 2 approvers; 48 h -> 24 h saved ("Version 2, last changed Oct 13, 2026, 12:24 PM.") -> restored

name: Audit log
expected: Events are listed newest first with who and why; filtering by event type works
actual: 26 events; filtered "ticket.revoked": ticket.revoked | Demo Administrator (admin) | Demonstration: wrong student at the desk

name: Operations and diagnostics
expected: Pending approval steps and email counts are shown; the consistency check agrees with itself
actual: waiting on approvers: ; email: queued 0 sending 0 failed 0 sent 11; "Everything agrees (checked Oct 13, 2026, 12:24 PM)."
